notes.title: 🗺️ Final Update for Rooms of Realities is now available 🌊
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, Adventurers: it's time for the finishing touches in Rooms of Realities[/h2]

[u][b]Some history:[/b][/u]

🔎Do you remember how it all started? First, we prepared a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3725082316354679491]demo[/url] of [b]Rooms of Realities[/b], and on June 13, 2023, we launched the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3683428365976521588]Early Access[/url] of the game. In that version, the entire "In the Shadows of the Pyramid" scenario was available. We were also ready for your feedback and to introduce further corrections and stories into the game.

Then, following [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471427349049]the roadmap[/url], we introduced further improvements to the game, as well as a new scenario, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471471427224]"The Forsaken Asylum"[/url] (in July), and the final set of escape rooms collected in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3650783611420245966]"Nemo's Mysterious Formula"[/url] scenario (in August). This progression culminated in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/6187444440715974360]release of the full version of the game[/url] on November 17, 2023, which included, among other features, Victory Rooms that allow you to pose for fancy, cool photos after completing the scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/fe16bce796fe078e026781ba43dae04da817fe3a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]What now:[/b][/u]

🔎Almost half a year has passed since the release of the full version of [b]Rooms of Realities[/b], and this project continues to bring us immense joy. We are pleased to announce another update aimed at enhancing the aspect of the game you've most frequently inquired about - extending the duration of the third act in the "The Forsaken Asylum" scenario.

[b]The Final Update[/b] also enhances interactions with certain items, especially levers, and optimizes game physics, particularly during online play with friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/2eff0a10ac5ff244c8a9660c8d343a888af4cd9a.jpg[/img]

[b][u]What’s next?[/u][/b]

🔎We know that many of you enjoyed our approach to virtual Escape Rooms and that some of you would like to see more [b]Rooms of Realities[/b]. Currently, we are not yet ready to reveal our future plans, but stay tuned to see what else we come up with in the future!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

[i]~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: 💎 The Final Update is coming! 🌀
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/6738eb4b00c9de65329687ebfdc9bea14827fcfb.png[/img]
[h3]Dear players, dear fans of Escape Rooms: we are grateful to you for supporting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/]Rooms of Realities [/url]project.[/h3]

Last year, we had a successful [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3683428365976521588?l=english]Early Access[/url] launch, following which we improved the game with frequent updates and, above all, with two large scenarios: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471471427224]The Forsaken Asylum[/url][/b] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3650783611420245966][b]Nemo's Mysterious Formula[/b][/url] (each of them consisted of three rooms). Then [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/6187444440715974360][b]version 1.0 was released[/b][/url], and you can fully enjoy it!

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🌀🌀🌀

It was a time of increased effort and work for us. We have drawn many conclusions and observations from it, thanks to which we are moving forward, but before we do that, we want to release a [b]Final Update of the game[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/d8764b5be0d96772e797038463b1570ed2447ac6.jpg[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🌀🌀🌀

[h2]Update details:[/h2]

[b]The update will be free and will appear on May 9, 2024[/b]. Its main role will be to e[b]xpand the third chapter in The Forsaken Asylum scenario[/b], which was reported as being a little too short and requires expansion. We now have the opportunity to respond to your feedback and provide a new, larger, and updated version of this part of the game. We hope you will come back to check it out and enjoy discovering the secrets hidden in Rooms of Realities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/4bd813846121da6227c8f36f6ba95f9f8d36c8c8.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

For now, you can check out fragments of the new version of the scenario in the attached screenshots. Take care!

[i]~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: Let's start the adventure - Rooms of Realities version 1.0 awaits!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/9122019179d3c6bb2d8080005dd48005982db8a9.png[/img]
Hello, all Adventurers and Puzzle Solvers,

After five months of intense work, effort and collecting feedback, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/][b]Rooms of Realities[/b][/url] is finally available in version 1.0! Welcome to our collection of Escape Rooms.

[previewyoutube=MfPxiJTQ9g8;full][/previewyoutube]

Check them out by playing the way you like - in single-player mode or in cooperation with up to four people. The rooms are prepared in such a way that both versions will offer just as fun experience. Check out what Rooms of Realities consists of now!

[h3]Three unique scenarios, each consisting of three chapters[/h3]

🔥 [b]In the Shadow of the Pyramids[/b], the scenario begins by leading us to the tent where researchers study ancient artifacts, and then it guides us into the heart of the pyramid. What mysteries lie concealed within its depths, and how can we illuminate chambers that have remained shrouded in darkness for centuries?

🔥 Embark on the [b]Forsaken Asylum scenario[/b], where your primary instinct is to escape the eerie surroundings. Luckily, a whimsical specter is on hand to offer guidance. We've crafted a humorous homage to the classic horror films, ensuring an atmosphere that is spooky but intentionally devoid of fear and tension.

🔥 Explore the [b]Nemo's Mysterious Formula[/b] scenario, immersing yourself in the depths of an abandoned submarine amidst extraordinary phenomena. Is there a watchful presence observing your every move? Plunge into a unique escape room adventure and unravel the secrets of a legendary sea treasure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/dde740621258bbae3f35dd229232da9d1512d852.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements in 1.00[/h3]

🔶 Experience the newly [b]renovated Lobby stage[/b] featuring enhanced graphics, updated models, designated spaces for cassettes, and new decorations.
🔶 Discover [b]three Collectibles in each chapter,[/b] totaling 27: collectible blue orbs that become visible in the Lobby.
🔶 Enjoy an [b]enhanced music direction [/b]for an improved auditory experience.
🔶[b] Victory Rooms[/b] - once you finish a whole scenario, you get access to a Victory
Room with special animations and interactions such as taking a selfie.

[h3]Core Features of the Game[/h3]

🔷 [b]Engaging puzzle-solving:[/b] Search for artifacts, immersing yourself in the role of a hero from an adventure movie.
🔷 [b]Scenarios designed for short sessions:[/b] divided into three chapters for convenient gameplay.
🔷 [b]VR immersion:[/b] Utilize VR technology to explore meticulously crafted environments.
🔷 [b]Socialization:[/b] spend time with friends in a Lobby featuring trophies, and a tutorial.
🔷 [b]Inclusivity:[/b] Rooms of Realities caters to all skill levels, emphasizing thinking and puzzle-solving over reflexes.
🔷[b] Ample amusing interactions:[/b] Play with virtual objects within any virtual room setting.
🔷 [b]Flexibility:[/b] Comfortably play solo or team up with two, three, or four friends.
🔷[b] Comfort:[/b] Intuitive interface for seamless movement and object interaction.

[h3]A word from us[/h3]

With the release of version 1.00, we are incredibly happy to be bringing our game into the world.

We aim to bring joy and lots of smiles to your experience in Rooms of Realities, especially when enjoying it with friends. Dive into the scenarios and make sure to share with us which one captured your preference the most!


~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

notes.title: Pick Your Challenge Update for Yupitergrad 2 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/6ea62e6440b35671e6e5625f73002d8350920b0b.png[/img]
We’re back, Cosmonauts

While gathering feedback from our community, we found out that you need new challenges and that you like swinging around space stations so much - Following our recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1969000/view/3745363008535929265?l=english]"Comfort Zone"[/url] Update aimed at enhancing your gaming experience, we're here with some cosmic news – [b]it's time for the "Pick Your Challenge Update."[/b]

[h3]Introducing Difficulty Levels and Modifiers[/h3]

So, what’s new? Now, you have the power to tailor the challenge to your liking with our [b]newly minted difficulty levels:[/b]

🌟 Easy: In this setting, the game is exceptionally forgiving, and your adversaries won't drain your energy as swiftly.
🌟 Normal: The current difficulty level you're familiar with.
🌟 Hard: Brace yourself for an intense cosmic ride! In this mode, the slightest misstep could mean instant peril. It's a realm exclusively for the most skilled astronauts among you!

We've also introduced something even more captivating: [b]a total of nine options to fine-tune the game's difficulty, [/b]allowing everyone to set their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/][b]Yupitergrad 2[/b][/url] experience to their liking.

[h3]Here are the settings you can now find in the game options menu:[/h3]

💥 Enemies bullets speed - Adjust the rate of fire for enemy projectiles.
💥 Enemies damage - Customize the lethality of enemy bullets.
💥 Enemies health - Set the health levels for opponents.
💥 Enemies movement speed - Modify the agility and pace of enemy movements.
💥 Enemies shield - Define the resilience of enemy shields.
💥 Enemies shield orb spawn probability - Control the likelihood of shield orbs spawning.
💥 Minigun overheat time - Fine-tune the cooling time for your minigun.
💥 Traps damage - Determine the severity of trap effects.
💥 Closed atmospheric levels - Enhance maneuverability within enclosed atmospheric environments.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]Yupitergrad 2[/url] was originally designed with a singular difficulty level in mind, making the task of adapting more difficulty levels, and variables a cosmic puzzle in itself. Nevertheless, we've tuned various gameplay elements to ensure that everyone, from seasoned space acrobats to professional adventurers, can relish the Yupitergrad 2 experience.

🤖Now, after this update, we are excited to see even more people enjoying the exhilaration of swinging around [b]The Lost Station[/b].🤖

Stay with us and wait for more news about what we are preparing in the future. Supporting our games is a key priority for us - and we're already full of ideas about what else we can do.

Have fun, astronauts!

[previewyoutube=4Ic0FFPukZI;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/

notes.title: Rooms of Realities Version 1.00 - New release date!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/5a7f024b06be61e70360fd37dcacadce32f17c0f.png[/img]
Greetings, fellow gamers, and adventurers,

As you may recall, we recently [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3698073943481606977]shared our anticipation for the exit from Early Access[/url], with plans originally set for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471427349049]September.[/url] However, due to some unexpected twists, we need to inform you that the release of version 1.00 of the game will be slightly delayed, [b]with the new date set for November 17th.[/b]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🕸️🕸️🕸️⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 

[h3]So, what's happening during this time?[/h3]

First and foremost, we improve the [b]quality of interaction and comfort of gaming[/b], which is crucial in VR. We're also introducing a treasure trove of [b]collectibles[/b] and emphasizing the importance of certain events in the game, ensuring your experience is nothing short of extraordinary.

We take great care to ensure that the nine chapters we have delivered so far look as good as possible. All of this is to enable us to further develop [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/]Rooms of Realities[/url] and deliver the absolute best in gaming enjoyment (and to further develop this project).
Thank you!

[previewyoutube=ra1DJAeWOQw;full][/previewyoutube]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🕸️🕸️🕸️⠀
We'd like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all those who've been with us during the Early Access phase. We sincerely apologize for any discrepancies between our initial announcements and the current timeline for reaching version 1.00. [b]Rest assured, the delay is minor, and the official premiere is just around the corner.[/b] Please stay by our side as we work relentlessly to deliver a unique gaming experience.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to embark on this adventure with you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

notes.title: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station - Steam version arrived 🚀
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/ddd0f667b8d30623cc0b152a855ba867b8964f8c.png[/img]

Space comrades, it's time to grab your kosmo-sticks and go on a journey through the abandoned space station 🪐

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]This is our most important and greatest journey[/url] - after Yupitergrad 2 was released on Pico, Meta and HTC headsets, [b]it's finally time for the Steam version.[/b] 😉

We're thrilled that new users will have the opportunity to explore the enigmatic space base's intricate corridors and passages. [b]This facility is overseen by a defiant artificial intelligence, which means players will need to demonstrate their skills, acquire fresh equipment, and engage in combat against rebel robots. [/b]Moreover, there will be [b]more environmental puzzles to unravel and a greater map to navigate[/b] in order to make their escape. We have prepared something fresh for you in VR and present a real [b]space Metroidvania[/b] in this game.

[previewyoutube=4Ic0FFPukZI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]👇 What awaits you in Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station? 👇[/h3]

🚀 [b]Campaign for 6-8 hours[/b] filled with jokes and comments from AISha - the artificial intelligence that accompanies us

🚀 [b]8 unique types of traps[/b] in different variations - which must be avoided showing off efficiency and precision

🚀 [b]3 visually distinct biomes[/b] featuring a variety of locations and numerous points of interest, making it easier to navigate and orient oneself in the field.

🚀 [b]4 distinct pieces of equipment[/b] designed for both exploration and combat, enabling access to new areas and the ability to confront robots effectively.

And above all, it's a blast! We've designed fantastic spaces where you can swing and experiment with game mechanics, thanks to our one-of-a-kind suction cups on the ropes. It's an exceptional blend of environmental exploration, 3D platforming, shooting, and adventure gaming. Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station is a unique VR experience

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/

It's important to highlight that [b]Yupitergrad 2 on Steam is essentially version 1.1 of the game,[/b] which has already been launched on other platforms. In this release, you'll have [b]immediate access to gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and functional fixes[/b] that were introduced in the latest update on other platforms. Our priority is to ensure that your experience is as seamless and polished as can be.

Stick around and keep an eye out for more updates! May the vastness of space, our nerdy humor, and the thrilling adventures in the corridors bring you as much joy as they do for us!

[i]~Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: Nemo’s Mysterious Formula - three new chapters for Rooms of Realities are waiting
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/2c73844ab9d0e8e1ccf51fd0de2906a14b4ecb08.png[/img]
[h3]If you have already solved the puzzles of the last two scenarios, we have something fresh for you 👇
[/h3]

Hello dear adventurers, we understand the importance of adding new content to puzzle-solving games, especially during the Early Access phase. That's why we are thrilled to announce [b]the release of three new chapters for Rooms of Realities (for free!). These chapters are part of the Nemo's Mysterious Formula scenario, offering even more exciting puzzles for players to solve. [/b]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⚓ 🦈⚓

Nemo's Mysterious Formula is an [b]exhilarating expedition to an abandoned submarine![/b] Embark on a thrilling journey filled with challenges, puzzles, and surprises. Brace yourself for the unexpected as you unravel the secrets lurking within the depths of this enigmatic vessel. Get ready to dive into the immersive world of Nemo's Mysterious Formula - are you ready to uncover the mysteries that lie within?

notes.title: 🤖 Yupitergrad 2 Coming to Steam September 7th - Add to Wishlist!
notes.content:
[h3]🔥🔥We've been waiting a long time to tell you the good news - from [b]September 7th[/b] you will be able to get Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station on Steam! 🔥🔥[/h3]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🌕🌕🌕
👉 [b]What happened and where are we:[/b]

Thank you to all the players who have supported us since the launch of our game on the Meta Store, HTC Vive, and Pico! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we want you to know that we are continuously working on improving your gaming experience.

🚀[b]We are excited to inform you that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]Steam version[/url] of our game has been updated to address occasional space station navigation issues and resolve various minor bugs. In addition, we have made numerous improvements to the game's environment, including the skybox, decoration elements, markings, and unified texts[/b].

[previewyoutube=AEQH_eqBE3E;full][/previewyoutube]

With the Steam release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station[/url],[b] you will receive version 1.1 of the game[/b], packed with enhancements and visual upgrades, right from the start. We are committed to delivering the best possible gaming experience, and we hope you enjoy the improved gameplay and immersive environment.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🌕🌕🌕
👉 [b]What will happen and where are we going:[/b]

The launch is a key milestone for the game, but [b]it won't be the last[/b]. In the coming weeks we will tell you what other improvements are coming to Yupitergrad 2 and how it will develop.

The fact that we managed to make [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pVHP0t5ACgo&list=PLtxdp6Hbnr127rvKoSrSpAjjUZxupWQlU&index=4]Metroidvania in VR[/url] is one thing - because despite this, we still want to add new features to the game, to improve its quality and give players the opportunity to have fun in many ways.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🌕🌕🌕


🌼It's still a bit too early to reveal anything more, but we assure you that it's worth the wait to see what else we have to show. Be with us, wait for more information and don't save yourself in opinions about what things you want to see in VR. We listen to your voices and look forward to them. Thanks to them we can do better things!

[i]~Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: Puzzle Fest demo of Rooms of Realities is out!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40000399/fb08c7f0e556772406afcdd7d3b9fd14a79e187f.png[/img]
[h3]Play with everyone! It's time to unravel the mystery of the Pyramid, check out a snippet of what you can expect from the full version of Rooms of Realities.[/h3]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🗝️🗝️🗝️

We're happy to announce that with the launch of [b]Puzzle Fest[/b], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/]you can now play the [b]Rooms of Realities demo[/b][/url]. This is a unique test for us because we are combining [b]co-op, escape rooms and VR[/b] in one title (although whether you play solo or co-op is up to you - the puzzles in the game adapt to it!) so we are very keen to get feedback from you before the premiere!

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🗝️🗝️🗝️

🎗️As we [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3725082316339620451?l=english]announced on Friday[/url] - please note that the [b]demo currently works on Meta headsets[/b] (Quest 1,2, Pro), but we will support more hardware until launch.
🎗️If you are interested in exploring the world, we also have good news for you, because although there is currently a fragment of the scenario set in Egypt, [b]two more new settings will be available during the release of the full version[/b].

notes.title: Celebrating the end of Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/a21e274d86bac5c8b6763958749477b2e6b5b2a6.jpg[/img]
Hi!

We have [b]two good news[/b] for you. First: [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b] is about to leave [b]Early Access[/b]. Second: before that happens, you can buy the game at a [b]promotional price[/b].

On [b]August 1-8[/b], you can buy BFO with an 34% discount. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/62b33d8df46b633bc3e9d1a2647430fdb65a75ec.gif[/img]

We have prepared such an offer because we know that many of you are still watching our project. 
Over the past weeks, we've added many features, additional forklifts, a warehouse, Steering Wheel support, VR+HOTAS combo, FOV, key presets and binding, Point Shop and Community Items, ultra-wide screen support, and there will even be an [b]Arcade Mode[/b] in 1.00 version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/5ca40a06a3d0ca237128d919d3224b8b72afc1a8.gif[/img]

[h3]That is why [b]we want to be transparent[/b] and inform you that with the premiere of the full version, the [b]price of the game will be increased[/b] to $19.99.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/3f42e380671f2628cdf6ca4d345b245092dfbede.gif[/img]

Therefore, if you want to drive fantastic forklifts, on flat screens or in VR, [b]now is an opportunity[/b] to do it at a very affordable price which is [b]only half of the base price[/b] when BFO will leave EA..

The game will leave [b]Early Access[/b] on [b]August 11t[/b]h. We will write about the details of what will be added in the update to version 1.00 in the following news.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684670/Best_Forklift_Operator/
…and since you are already reading this - [b]thank you[/b] again for supporting us all the time and sending your feedback! It is largely [b]thanks to the community[/b] of contributing players that [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b] has been able to become a better game.
Much love!

[i]~Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: 💪 Gymnasion 🦾
notes.content:
[h1]Komrades, we have something special for you[/h1]

You have been with us for [b]many[/b] months and we still receive feedback from you about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352020/Yupitergrad/]Yupitergrad[/url]. That's why we want to give you something special:

[h3]🏋🏻 Gymnasion mode is now available in the game! 🏋🏻[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352020/Yupitergrad/

What is [b]Gymnasion[/b]? 🤔
It’s the largest gym in space - a place where[b] everyone can swing freely and practice crazy acrobatics[/b]. Here you can play with the game mechanics and test maneuvers that can be useful later in the [b]Time Attack[/b] mode or in the campaign.

[b]Developing this mode was great joy and fun[/b] - not only because it was an idea we had in mind for some time, but also [b]because the community themselves asked us to do something like this[/b]. It's great that our thoughts and wishes could meet in such a place.

Now there are no excuses ;) - we invite you to play Gymnasion!

Fly high, and stay safe Komrades! 🕊️

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GameDust]~Gamedust Team[/url][/i]
